# Gate 0 pull_request paths filter (FAR-673, ADR 031 Decision 10).
#
# ALWAYS-RUN patterns: a change to any of these paths MUST trigger the
# native Gate 0 workflow (.github/workflows/native-gate0.yml) even when
# the PR looks otherwise launcher-unrelated, because the native bundle
# boots these modules directly and a regression here is invisible to the
# Compose-only CI until a release smoke fails.
#
# Extend this list when a new module joins the launcher's direct boot
# path; backend/tests/unit/tools/test_gate0_paths.py asserts the critical
# modules stay covered, so removing one of the patterns below without a
# matching test update fails the unit suite.
backend/src/modulo/db/**
backend/src/modulo/settings.py
backend/src/modulo/db/url_utils.py
backend/src/modulo/api/main.py
deploy/fly/**
